name: r9club-automix
description: R9CLUB AUTOMIX - intelligent anchor-aligned audio arrangement for Windows and macOS
author: R9CLUB

scripts.build:native:win: cargo build --manifest-path native/wasapi-player/Cargo.toml --locked --release && dotnet publish native/asio-player/R9Club.AsioPlayer.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:DebugType=None -o native/asio-player/publish && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force electron/native | Out-Null; Copy-Item native/wasapi-player/target/release/r9club-wasapi-player.exe electron/native/wasapi-player.exe -Force; Copy-Item native/asio-player/publish/r9club-asio-player.exe electron/native/asio-player.exe -Force"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:native:win && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --publish never
